description: Cross-platform capabilities for the main window. The frontend is a static SvelteKit app that fetches its data from free-steam-games.win over plain HTTP, so it needs two native bridges: shell:open, which opens external links the webview otherwise blocks, and app exit, which quits the app when the reader declines the terms (core:default does not include it, and the window's close() does nothing on Android). The desktop-only updater lives in updater.json so the Android/iOS build, which does not compile that plugin, does not fail ACL resolution.
